Good morning. I see you've had fatigue, flank pain, and fever after recent antibiotics for sinusitis; have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood, cloudiness, or increased frequency?

speaker: Doctor
text: Those eosinophilic casts in your urine are highly suggestive of acute interstitial nephritis, likely a delayed allergic reaction to the antibiotics you took. Did the flank pain begin shortly after starting the antibiotic treatment, or did it appear later? Have you noticed any rash, hives, or swelling since taking the medication?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN) secondary to antibiotic hypersensitivity. The presence of eosinophiluria and leukocyturia in the absence of bacteria, combined with the temporal relationship to antibiotic use and systemic symptoms like fever and fatigue, strongly supports this diagnosis.
